name: agent-steps
title: Agent Steps
description: An agent narrating its own work: the prompt lands in a pill, and under it a log writes itself one line at a time — each step running with a faint spinning globe, then flipping to past tense behind a check while the whole column steps up a row so the live line always sits on the centre. When the work is done the column swells and clears, and the last line slides to the middle and becomes the answer. Every proportion and every curve is fitted from frame measurements.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/ai-input/agent-steps?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.
